meaning: The Model evaluated by this quorum.
The wallet that opened the quorum and paid its rent.
Caller-chosen u64 nonce deriving the Quorum PDA `["quorum", model, caller, nonce_le]`.
32-byte SHA-256 hash of the input envelope that every cited receipt must match.
Minimum number of matching receipts required to agree (`MIN_QUORUM_VOTES = 2` to `MAX_QUORUM_VOTES = 5`).
When true, `distinct_enclaves >= required_votes` is enforced; when false, repeated calls to the same enclave count as repeatability proofs.
32-byte SHA-256 output hash shared by all verified receipts once `Agreed` (all zero while `Open`).
Count of verified matching receipts recorded on finalization (`0` while `Open`).
Count of distinct enclaves among the verified receipts (`0` while `Open`).
Fixed 5-slot array holding the verified canonical `Receipt` PDA addresses (unused trailing slots are the default address).
The slot the quorum was opened in.
The slot `finalize_quorum` sealed consensus in (`0` while `Open`).
